mapping.summary: Point layer of UKCS offshore surface infrastructure (platforms, buoys, terminals, FPSOs). Each point is mapped by its INF_TYPE to the closest offshore structure symbol; status is not shown.

rules.note: Generic platform symbol; platform function not recorded
Offshore loading terminal closest match for floating storage/loading
Buoy; lights not recorded, assumed without light
Monitor buoy; assumed buoy without light

caveats: STATUS (active, not in use, abandoned, removed) has no matching SSL point symbol; it is not shown.
Platform function (production, drilling, injection) is not recorded, so generic platform symbol is used.
FLARE STACK and OTHER (SURFACE) have no matching symbol; they get the generic platform default at low confidence.
NAME has too many distinct values to map on.
